Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim file purposes. Can you
confirm you're comfortable continuing?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Great. Can you walk me through what happened on the day of the accident?
A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Sugar Land, in the right lane. Traffic had been moving slowly. The
next thing I knew, I felt a hard jolt from behind and my head snapped back against the headrest.
Q: Did you see the vehicle coming before the impact?
A: No. I was looking ahead at the light. I heard tires and then the impact.
Q: Were you able to get out of your car afterward?
A: Yes, but I felt stiff. Within an hour my lower back was really tight and sore, and by that evening it was shooting pain
down my left leg.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the next morning. They took x-rays, said there was no fracture, and diagnosed a
back strain. They gave me muscle relaxers and told me to rest and do stretching.
Q: Are you still having symptoms?
A: Yes. I still get stiffness when I sit for long periods, and I've had to cut back on lifting at work. I have a follow-up with
my primary care doctor next week.
Q: Did you have any pain or problems with your back before this accident?
A: I had some occasional stiffness after long shifts, but nothing that stopped me from working or needed treatment.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Just that I'm trying to get back to normal and I want the claim handled fairly.
Q: Thank you. We'll be in touch with next steps. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.
